patch.value: Preserve imported GitHub lifetimes, closure evidence and release attribution while linking cross-provider items

Repair the import root cause behind twelve Sourcery findings across six gated sync PRs. Preserve source timestamps through supported SDK metadata, map closure reasons and evidence, select tag-date release windows, report state conflicts, and link existing provider owners before creating items. Verify with recorded API fixtures and real temporary trackers at unchanged release gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Read all twelve unresolved Sourcery threads and the changed tracker/changelog files in the six consumer sync PRs. Scope: fix import only; preserve append-only history and leave unrelated closeout work untouched. The pinned SDK exposes completedAt but reserves created_at, updated_at and closed_at; source timestamp metadata plus an explicit SDK-gap receipt is required unless a supported import path proves otherwise. No upstream SDK issue will be filed under the queue rules.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Found public SDK import primitives beyond high-level create/update: item locks, canonical document serialization, before/after history entries and appendHistoryEntry. Implementing an idempotent finalization event with real native dates and source metadata, without modifying any historical record. Existing provider owners receive provenance links only; their content, native lifecycle, release and export identity remain authoritative. Local Git calendar tag dates select the first release at or after source closure; later closures remain pending. GraphQL ClosedEvent closer provides actual closing PR attribution where REST commit_id is null.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: SDK candidate: bulk compensation captures native updated_at and passes it to restore as a history timestamp. Backdating that field disconnects the rollback version from its event. Preserve source creation/closure/completion natively for momentum and cycle time, and retain the exact source update date in github_updated_at while native updated_at stays the SDK mutation clock. Lifecycle finalization now runs at the SDK committing transition before the journal commits, with real compensation acceptance and a post-recovery idempotent check. No historical entries are rewritten.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Verified the SDK candidate with a real temporary tracker and public commitImportedItem/commitItemMutations calls: a historical native updated_at followed by an update and deliberate committing failure produces AggregateError, compensation_failed=true, original_restored=false. The importer retains the exact source update timestamp in github_updated_at while keeping native updated_at aligned with immutable event time. Real importer rollback acceptance restores the existing source lifecycle and deletes the newly created item. Focused corrections passed 7/7; final linked tests and unchanged full release gates are running.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The source-date, provider-link, privacy-plan and invalid-lifetime targeted checks pass 9/9 after certified SDK corpus reads replaced repeated CLI reads. A real tracker exposed the remaining canceled-to-completed transition: the SDK requires explicit repeat-closure authorization. Import reconciliation uses that supported transition with source closure evidence, and both modes now exercise canceled, completed and reopened states. The earlier release-gate probe had obsolete fixture assumptions and was stopped; final gates will run after these corrections.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Terminal reconciliation checks pass 3/3: canceled source records become completed when GitHub does, and reopen clears terminal evidence, in both import modes. Expanded provider matching also follows generic url/external_links when a provider id or tag declares ownership. Final release gates are being restarted against this complete implementation; no coverage thresholds, exemptions or dependency pins changed.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioral revert proof at implementation 5999329: scratch copies retained the real recorded-API and temporary-tracker tests, rebuilding before each independent function control. Omitting persistImportFidelity yields 9 expected failures across source lifetime fixtures and state-conflict scenarios. Restoring generic importCloseReason wording yields 2 expected failures (beads and slack-standup); dropping linked closure evidence yields 1 (brief closing PR). Tag-only matchImportedIssue yields 2 expected failures (plain and atomic provider owner linking). Clearing buildImportFidelity release attribution yields 1 expected failure in the two-tag before/between/after fixture. Total: 15 expected behavioral failures, zero passes, skips or cancellations; no SDK mocks. Positive targeted checks passed 9/9, terminal transitions 3/3 and expanded identity checks 2/2. Full unchanged release gates remain in progress.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The broad gate exposed a real adapter defect for callers passing a repository root: readSettings used the unresolved path, and finalization could append history using a noncanonical item id. Atomic planning now resolves the tracker first; finalization normalizes the id before locking, writing history and invoking hooks. The existing full gate/strict-health fixture and an explicit shortened-id finalization assertion cover this. Updated legacy HTTP replay fixtures to serve closure timelines, and the recovered-journal assertion now expects the earlier explicit no-push refusal. The broad run is diagnostic while these corrections are verified; final release gates will be rerun against frozen source.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Canonical-id finalization, both repaired HTTP closure fixtures and recovered-journal refusal pass their targeted assertions. The clean strict-health/push/no-op flow now asserts the correct durable-journal recovery counts and passes; the concurrent two-process race also passes with five distinct comments, keeping the production lock wait and every deduplication assertion unchanged. Refused source cancellation and refused provider-link tests pass 2/2 with real tracker writes, recorded HTTP fixtures and CLI fault boundaries; neither can pass the gate or create a duplicate. Pinned typecheck and test compilation pass. Strict health passes with an isolated global registry; default local health sees a pre-existing shared-registry host-version skew. No dependency or registry changes made. Final PM-linked fixtures and unchanged full release gates are now running against frozen source.

Closing commit attribution respects the API commit repository URL. Final fixture suite now contains 29 tests; full unchanged gates remain pending.
